title: subagent-reliability
description: Root node for this proposal's curated project map.

title: cartographer-pathfinder agent
description: Single-phase implementation worker prompt that owns edits, receipts, validation evidence, and blocker reporting.
why_relevant: Primary Cartographer worker agent to harden after worker handoff failures.

title: cartographer-auditor agent
description: Read-only semantic auditor prompt intended to run after deterministic validation receipts.
why_relevant: Addresses the missed-auditor completion gate reported from the session.

title: cartographer-compass agent
description: Scope, dependency, and repeated-failure decision advisor for timeout loops, plan drift, and blocker escalation.
why_relevant: Should be invoked after repeated subagent/tool failures or unclear next steps.

title: cartographer-drafter agent
description: Proposal/plan artifact drafter that consumes compact map/fact/context inputs and should remain distinct from review/worker roles.
why_relevant: Drafter boundaries should align with mandatory auditor completion gates.

title: proposal skill
description: Proposal workflow that chooses subagents, validates proposal artifacts, handles private evidence, and declares completion readiness.
why_relevant: Needs deterministic validation plus auditor completion gate to prevent premature proposal completion.

title: plan skill
description: Planning workflow that uses drafter/auditor/compass roles, planning graph validation, and handoff readiness checks.
why_relevant: Needs explicit auditor gate and clearer fallback language aligned with Cartographer agents.

title: implement skill
description: Parent implementation workflow where pathfinder/worker dispatch, acceptance contracts, validation loops, auditor/reviewer gates, and ADR finalization are specified.
why_relevant: Primary workflow to change so workers finish bounded phase work and auditor gates cannot be skipped.

title: session analyzer
description: Sanitized Pi session JSONL analyzer that aggregates tool usage, errors, durations, repeated commands, compactions, and timeout indicators.
why_relevant: Should be improved to provide precise subagent timeout/error evidence for future reliability work.

title: session analyzer tests
description: Unit tests for sanitized session analysis behavior, secret redaction, invalid lines, tool counts, and timeout reporting.
why_relevant: Needs coverage for timeout overmatching and child-duration diagnostics if analyzer changes.

title: workflow docs tests
description: Unit tests asserting workflow guidance remains documented across proposal, plan, implement, and README artifacts.
why_relevant: Can lock in auditor-gate and acceptance-contract documentation after the workflow changes.

title: README package docs
description: User-facing package documentation for Cartographer subagents and workflow guarantees.
why_relevant: Should document hardened subagent contracts and auditor/acceptance expectations after implementation.

title: package manifest and scripts
description: Package metadata and validation scripts for typecheck, Python lint/format, and test suites.
why_relevant: Defines validation commands for implementation phases.
